style_when: the story is about change after hours — automation displacing shifts, a market open all night, capacity running while people sleep
prompt: Architectural photograph at blue hour. A newly framed timber accessory dwelling unit (ADU) stands in a residential backyard, glowing from a single warm amber workman's site lamp inside the unfinished drywall. In the foreground, the dark stucco wall and asphalt shingle roofline of the established main house sit in deep shadow. Slate gray and deep pine green ambient twilight contrasts with the bone white and rust tones of the raw construction. 35mm anamorphic wide lens, long-exposure calm, deep shadows, crisp crystalline air. No people, no text, no vehicles.

core_conflict: Frozen, expensive buy-side housing market vs. newly financeable, legally permitted build-side ADU additions
